title: Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Itsuwari no Yuusha Denshou

thread.title: Clevatess Season 2 • Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Akago to Shikabane no Yuusha Denshou - Episode 9 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters enjoyed Alicia returning to her normal appearance and praised her resilience, comedic timing, and continued appeal as a character.
The thread frequently found the episode’s dark humor effective, especially the contrast between grim situations and absurd physical comedy.
Several commenters liked the horror atmosphere, unusual setting, and the episode’s expansion of the show’s mythology.
The princess and dean revelations generated substantial interest, but many viewers found the identities and twists difficult to follow.
One recurring complaint was that the episode felt too short, reinforcing frustration that the weekly installments provide very little runtime.
Fan-service was widely noticed and often welcomed, though some reactions treated it as excessive or conspicuously inserted.
